data.one_liner: Flutter package that provides you clippers to create tickets.
data.what_it_does: Provides ticket clippers to create ticket-shaped widgets in Flutter. Includes support for rounded edges and box shadows.
use_when: You want to design ticket-style UI elements in your app
You need custom clipper widgets with shadow effects
avoid_when: You do not need custom ticket shapes or clippers
strengths: Easy to integrate into existing Flutter layouts
Supports customized shadows and radius configuration
data.minimal_example:
TicketClipper(
  clipper: TicketRoundedEdgeClipper(
      edge: Edge.horizontal,
      position: 150,
      radius: 25,
    ),
    shadowRadius: ShadowRadius.circular(20),
    shadow:  const BoxShadow(
      color: Color.fromARGB(255, 4, 234, 250),
      offset: Offset(12, 12),
    ),
    child: Container(),
)
